# Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/enterprise-patterns/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/enterprise-patterns
```

- 38 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/enterprise-patterns:enterprise-patterns-<name>`.
- 21 subagents, started with `@enterprise-patterns-<name> <task>`.
